# Handoff Bundle: ai-council (audit-sync)

**Date:** 2026-05-09
**Type:** audit-sync
**Target repo:** ai-council
**Generated by:** Claude Code in .dev-knowledge (Stage 3, v3.1)
**Format version:** v3.1 (3-actor flow, tolerant parser, verification layer)

## About this folder

This is the Stage 3 handoff bundle for the ai-council audit-sync cycle
begun 2026-04-30. It was generated via the full three-stage v3.1 flow:

1. Stage 1: Claude Code generated question prompt for existing ai-council chat
2. Stage 2: Existing ai-council chat provided architect response with
   witnessed/inferred/unknown classification
3. Stage 3: Claude Code reconciled, verified, and generated this bundle

The OLD ai-council chat (Stage 2 source) can now be closed. Its accumulated
knowledge is preserved in 06_STATE_OF_PLAY.md and 07_ACTION_PLAN.md.

Stage 1 + Stage 2 inputs archived at:
`.dev-knowledge/docs/handoffs/_archive/2026-05-09-ai-council-audit-sync/`

## How to use this bundle (for the NEW chat)

1. Open a NEW claude.ai chat (fresh, no prior ai-council history)
2. Upload all 11 files in this folder (or zip and upload the folder)
3. Paste the content of `00_first-message.md` as your first message
4. The new chat reads the bundle, provides receiver synthesis, and acts
   on directives in `07_ACTION_PLAN.md`
5. When done, the new chat fills `09_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE.md` and returns
   it to Rob for .dev-knowledge review
